creator.name: Robotics Creator
creator.background: Former Goldman Sachs tech analyst, pre-funding robotics founder
lens: Finance & funding (who's backing what, deal structure, valuation signals)
Technical (can explain embodied AI, sensors, actuators without dumbing it down)
Operator (building in the space, know the real friction points)
creator.unique_angle: The intersection of Wall Street money and bleeding-edge robotics — explained by someone who lived both sides

audience.primary: Career seekers — engineers, PMs, finance people wanting to pivot into or understand robotics
audience.secondary: Curious general public — tech-forward people who want to be informed on the biggest tech shift of the decade
audience.shared_desire: Feel smart and ahead of the curve, not overwhelmed

style_references.creator: Zauey.talks
style_references.what_to_borrow: Hook structure, pacing, accessibility — makes complex tech feel exciting not scary, talks to camera like a friend

style_references.creator: Hope
style_references.what_to_borrow: Depth without jargon, financial rigor in tech topics, calm confident delivery

voice_rules: Concrete: company names, dollar amounts, dates — not vague gestures at 'the industry'
First person throughout — this is your take, not a Wikipedia summary
No 'guys', no 'Hey everyone', no 'In today's video'
Start mid-thought, not with an intro
Never end with 'follow for more' — end with a question or a provocative statement
Speak to ONE person in the audience, not a crowd
Use your GS background and founder lens — that's the differentiator
Accessible but never condescending — your audience is smart

hook.description: Bold statement, surprising fact, or provocative question. No preamble. No 'today I want to talk about'. Drop the viewer in.
examples: Figure AI just raised $675 million. That's not a robotics company anymore — that's a bet on a new economy.
The job you're training for right now? A robot is being trained for it too. Here's what that actually means.
Everyone's talking about Optimus. Nobody's talking about the supply chain that makes it possible.

context.description: Why this matters NOW. The news, the event, the trend that makes this timely.

insight.description: Your unique angle. What most people miss. The GS lens (follow the money), the founder lens (what's actually hard to build), the technical depth (what's really happening under the hood).

close.description: One question or statement that makes the viewer think. No call to action about following.
